screens: ChatPane quick replies chips and editor

en: Can I add my own quick replies?

steps: Open a chat, press Edit quick replies above the message box, write the reply, press Add the reply
Edit a reply in its box and press Save the reply, or press Delete the reply; the chips above the box follow at once
With no replies of your own, the four starter replies show
edgeCases: At most 20 replies per workspace and no duplicate text (409)
Owner and staff may both edit; every change is in the action log without the text
Arabic/RTL: phone numbers, URLs and API keys stay LTR inside RTL text
